title: MoonBoard Benchmark Score Benchmark Grade Leaderboard
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=moonboard:session
| stats avg(benchmark_points) as avg_value max(benchmark_points) as peak_value count as sessions by benchmark_grade
| sort - avg_value
description: Ranks benchmark grade values by average and peak benchmark points, helping you see where moonboard benchmark score performs best.
value: A simple leaderboard is an easy way to see which benchmark grade contexts are producing the strongest outcomes without deep analysis.
implementation: Populate `benchmark_grade` consistently from your export pipeline so the leaderboard can compare like with like.
visualization: Leaderboard table of benchmark grade, average benchmark points, and peak benchmark points.
grandmaExplanation: It checks which benchmark grade areas give you the strongest moonboard benchmark score results.
